spec: 3.7 V LiPo pouch with protection circuit (PCM), 2500–3000 mAh, ≤5 mm thick, at most 60 × 88 mm including the protection board (e.g. 505080, 5 × 50 × 80 mm), JST-PH 2.0 2-pin lead about 100 mm long
india: Robu.in / Lamington Road: search "3.7V 2500mAh 505080 lipo" or "3.7V 3000mAh lipo 5mm"
import: Avoid: batteries rarely ship to India from abroad
notes: Lies flat over the hotswap sockets under the outer and middle key columns, on a kapton sheet or thin printed shelf, at least 15 mm from the controller's antenna end. The connector is 70–80 mm from the cell, so a shorter lead needs a JST-PH 2.0 extension. Check the red wire lands on the PCB's + pad before plugging in.

spec: AO3401A P-channel MOSFET, SOT-23 (Q101/Q201)

spec: 1 MΩ resistor, 0805 (R101/R201)
